name: AfriMed-QA
intro: AfriMed-QA 是 QuarkMed 报告中提到的开放医疗问答数据集，覆盖非洲临床语境中的多样化医学问题。
org: Intron Health, Georgia Institute of Technology, Google Research, and collaborators
build_method: 医学题源整合, 临床标注, 多国家多专科覆盖
eval_feature: 医学问答, 非洲临床语境, 正确性与人口统计偏差
build_method_en: Medical source aggregation, clinical annotation, multi-country multi-specialty coverage
eval_feature_en: Medical QA, African clinical context, correctness and demographic bias
intro_en: AfriMed-QA is an open medical QA dataset referenced by QuarkMed reports, covering clinically diverse questions in African healthcare contexts.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect African medical sources"] --> B["Cover 16 countries"]
    B["Cover 16 countries"] --> C["Cover 32 medical specialties"]
    C["Cover 32 medical specialties"] --> D["Create open and closed QA"]
    D["Create open and closed QA"] --> E["Review clinical validity"]
    E["Review clinical validity"] --> F["Build 15,000 questions"]
    F["Build 15,000 questions"] --> G["Evaluate 30 LLMs"]
    G["Evaluate 30 LLMs"] --> H["Score correctness and bias"]

    B["覆盖16个国家"] --> C["覆盖32个医学专科"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.15640 and AfriMed-QA project/dataset materials. The paper introduces a Pan-African English medical QA benchmark with 15,000 open- and closed-ended questions sourced from more than 60 medical schools across 16 countries and 32 specialties, then evaluates 30 LLMs for correctness and demographic bias.
